title: fragaria vesca var. monophylla
intro: Fragaria vesca var. monophylla, commonly known as the Alpine strawberry, is a wild strawberry species native to Europe and parts of Asia. It is rich in nutrients and antioxidants, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory properties, improved cardiovascular health, and enhanced immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an antidiabetic, antihypertensive, and antineoplastic agent, suggesting potential in the management of diabetes, high blood pressure, and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Fragaria vesca var. monophylla include ellagic acid, flavonoids, and ascorbic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
